project: Get Sideways Artist OS Standalone Section Demo
business_data_policy: Business/venue data is separate and linked by venue_id/business_id/event_id.

pages.title: Live Availability Bar
pages.purpose: Shows whether the artist is live, accepting requests, on break, paused, or finished. This is the real-time layer that makes the page feel alive.

pages.title: Artist Profile Page
pages.purpose: The core public band profile: identity, lineup, genre, bio, member cards, and the main fan actions.

pages.title: Request a Song
pages.purpose: A fan submits a song request, receives a payment/reference code, and the request appears in the artist queue.

pages.title: Tip Jar
pages.purpose: Fans tip the band without needing a song request. Tips can be anonymous, public, or tied to a message.

pages.title: Paid Shoutout
pages.purpose: A shoutout is a paid product: birthdays, bachelorettes, anniversaries, business shoutouts, and dedications.

pages.title: Crowdfund a Song
pages.purpose: Fans contribute toward a song goal. The artist keeps control and approves what can actually be played.

pages.title: Upcoming Shows
pages.purpose: Artist event records link to venue IDs. The venue/business profile stays separate.

pages.title: Text Alerts / Fan Signup
pages.purpose: Turns a one-time show visitor into a reusable fan contact segmented by city, venue, and tourist/local status.

pages.title: Booking Inquiry
pages.purpose: Captures serious private-event, venue, wedding, corporate, college, and festival booking leads.

pages.title: Social Links
pages.purpose: Socials are important, but they should come after money actions so the page captures value before sending fans away.

pages.title: Merch Page
pages.purpose: Optional artist commerce: shirts, hats, stickers, pickup-at-show, ship later, and inventory fields.

pages.title: Vote Next Song
pages.purpose: Fans vote from artist-approved options. Easier and safer than open song requests.

pages.title: Sponsor Tonight’s Show
pages.purpose: A local business or fan can buy exposure: logo, stage shoutout, sponsored song, or weekend sponsorship.

pages.title: EPK / Press Kit
pages.purpose: For bookers and venues: quick band bio, photos, live clips, stage plot, tech rider, and downloadable assets.

pages.title: QR / NFC Manager
pages.purpose: The artist gets one link that can be printed on table tents, banners, stickers, wristbands, NFC cards, or social posts.

pages.title: Payment Verification Tracker
pages.purpose: Shows whether a request, tip, shoutout, sponsor, or merch payment has been matched by the parser.

pages.title: Email Parser Match Log
pages.purpose: This page shows the real engine: raw payment emails get turned into structured payment events.

pages.title: Admin Controls
pages.purpose: Artist/manager controls for what is live, paused, public, paid, requestable, and visible.

pages.title: Artist Dashboard
pages.purpose: The private dashboard where the artist sees money, requests, fans, booking leads, parser matches, and show performance.

pages.title: GCR Tourist Discovery
pages.purpose: The tourist side: things to do, places to eat, live music, late-night food, happy hours, and nearby events.

pages.title: Artist Data Structure
pages.purpose: The artist-only schema needed for CyberCheck Artist OS. Business/venue data is separate.
